blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate Public Relations and Information Bureau (PRIB) on Thursday apologized for the “accidental” fire transition effect that appeared while Sen. Alan Peter Cayetano was leading the opening prayer during the Senate impeachment court proceedings. The fiery effects, photos and video clips of which have since gone viral, appeared at Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial livestream at 10:03 a.m. while Cayetano was praying with his eyes closed.
